import os
import string
import random
import pytest
from pathlib import Path

# Import the public API that is expected to provide the required functionality.
# If any of these imports fail, the corresponding tests will be skipped.
try:
    from doorstop.core.document import Document
    from doorstop.core.item import Item
    from doorstop.common import DoorstopError
except Exception as exc:
    # If the core modules are not available, skip all tests.
    pytest.skip(f"NOT_IMPLEMENTED: required modules missing ({exc})", allow_module_level=True)


def _random_text(length: int) -> str:
    """Generate a random string of the given length."""
    return "".join(random.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + " ") for _ in range(length))


@pytest.fixture
def temp_doc(tmp_path: Path) -> Document:
    """Create a temporary Doorstop document for testing."""
    # The prefix is arbitrary; we use 'TEST' for clarity.
    doc = Document.new(prefix="TEST", path=tmp_path)
    # Ensure the document is persisted to disk.
    doc.save()
    return doc


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_001_store_requirement_normal(temp_doc: Document):
    """Requirement REQ-001 is stored and accessible with correct text."""
    uid = "REQ-001"
    text = "This is a normal requirement."
    # Add the requirement
    temp_doc.add_item(uid, text)
    # Reload the document to ensure persistence
    temp_doc.load()
    # Retrieve the item
    item = temp_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert item is not None, f"Requirement {uid} not found after addition"
    assert item.text == text, f"Stored text for {uid} does not match expected"


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_002_store_requirement_long_text(temp_doc: Document):
    """Requirement REQ-002 with 2000 characters is stored and fully retrievable."""
    uid = "REQ-002"
    long_text = _random_text(2000)
    temp_doc.add_item(uid, long_text)
    temp_doc.load()
    item = temp_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert item is not None, f"Requirement {uid} not found after addition"
    assert item.text == long_text, f"Stored text for {uid} is incomplete"


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_003_store_requirement_invalid_id(temp_doc: Document):
    """Adding a requirement with an invalid ID should raise an error and not store the item."""
    uid = "REQ-!"
    text = "Invalid ID test"
    with pytest.raises(DoorstopError, match="Invalid requirement ID format"):
        temp_doc.add_item(uid, text)
    # Ensure the item was not stored
    temp_doc.load()
    item = temp_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert item is None, f"Requirement {uid} should not have been stored"


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_004_change_requirement_normal(temp_doc: Document):
    """Requirement REQ-001 is updated and change is associated with developer ID."""
    uid = "REQ-001"
    original_text = "This is a normal requirement."
    temp_doc.add_item(uid, original_text)
    temp_doc.load()
    # Perform the change
    new_text = "This is an updated normal requirement."
    developer_id = "DEV-001"
    # The API for editing is assumed to be edit_item; we pass developer_id as metadata
    temp_doc.edit_item(uid, new_text, developer_id=developer_id)
    temp_doc.load()
    item = temp_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert item is not None, f"Requirement {uid} not found after edit"
    assert item.text == new_text, f"Requirement {uid} text was not updated"
    # Verify that the developer ID is recorded in the item's data
    assert getattr(item, "developer_id", None) == developer_id, (
        f"Developer ID {developer_id} not associated with requirement {uid}"
    )


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_005_change_requirement_long_text(temp_doc: Document):
    """Requirement REQ-003 with 1999 characters is updated and change is associated with developer ID."""
    uid = "REQ-003"
    original_text = "Short text."
    temp_doc.add_item(uid, original_text)
    temp_doc.load()
    new_text = _random_text(1999)
    developer_id = "DEV-001"
    temp_doc.edit_item(uid, new_text, developer_id=developer_id)
    temp_doc.load()
    item = temp_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert item is not None, f"Requirement {uid} not found after edit"
    assert item.text == new_text, f"Requirement {uid} text was not updated"
    assert getattr(item, "developer_id", None) == developer_id, (
        f"Developer ID {developer_id} not associated with requirement {uid}"
    )


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_006_change_requirement_empty_text(temp_doc: Document):
    """Requirement REQ-004 is updated with empty text and change is associated with developer ID."""
    uid = "REQ-004"
    original_text = "Initial text."
    temp_doc.add_item(uid, original_text)
    temp_doc.load()
    new_text = ""
    developer_id = "DEV-001"
    temp_doc.edit_item(uid, new_text, developer_id=developer_id)
    temp_doc.load()
    item = temp_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert item is not None, f"Requirement {uid} not found after edit"
    assert item.text == new_text, f"Requirement {uid} text was not updated to empty string"
    assert getattr(item, "developer_id", None) == developer_id, (
        f"Developer ID {developer_id} not associated with requirement {uid}"
    )


def test_U02_4__Gherkin_BDD___TC_007_change_requirement_non_existent(temp_doc: Document):
    """Attempting to change a non-existent requirement should raise an error."""
    uid = "REQ-999"
    new_text = "New Text"
    developer_id = "DEV-001"
    with pytest.raises(DoorstopError, match="Requirement not found"):
        temp_doc.edit_item(uid, new_text, developer_id=developer_id)
    # Ensure the requirement still does not exist
    temp_doc.load()
    item = temp_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert item is None, f"Requirement {uid} should not exist"

    uid = "REQ-005"

    temp_doc.add_item(uid, original_text)
    temp_doc.load()
    new_text = "Updated text"
    developer_id = "DEV-002"
    temp_doc.edit_item(uid, new_text, developer_id=developer_id)
